newsitem.title: UK: Russia to make presentation on economy Nov 11 week.
newsitem.headline: Russia to make presentation on economy Nov 11 week.

text.p: Russian officials will make presentations on the country's economy to international investors in the week starting Monday, November 11, J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg said on Friday.

"J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg will be holding presentations on the economy of the Russian Federation, to be given by a senior delegation from the Ministry of Finance and the central bank of the Russian Federation (in Asia, Europe and the U.S.)," the banks said in a statement.
"Presentations will begin in Asia and Europe during the week of November 11, ending in New York on November 20," the statement said.
The Euromarket expects the Ministry officials to include discussions on Russia's long-awaited debut Eurobond.
J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg are joint lead managers of the transaction which was expected to be for up to $500 million with a five-year maturity.
Analysts have said that a five-year deal could be priced at 350-400 basis points over the equivalent U.S. Treasury notes.
Moody's Investors Service has issued a prospective Ba2 sovereign ceiling on the foreign currency debt.
Standard & Poor's Corp awarded it a BB-minus foreign currency debt rating.
The roadshow is likely to coincide with the return of an International Monetary Fund mission to Russia to discuss disbursal of the latest tranche of the IMF's $10 billion loan to Russia.
The Russian central bank said on Thursday the mission was leaving after failing to reach agreement with Russian officials, and would return in the first half of November.
It could also coincide with an operation for heart surgery on President Boris Yeltsin, which officials say is likely to take place in the second half of November.
